svg.title: Gameplay feature implementation evidence
svg.desc: 14 of 20 tracked systems observed working with bounded evidence; 3 partially verified; 3 not yet verified. Unverified does not mean unimplemented. Not overall completion.
svg.text: 20 tracked systems. Native observations establish bounded implementation evidence.

g.title: Movement, jumps and net climbing: observed-bounded — Normal running, jumping, wall jumps and roof crawling in the accepted Pinna3 route; not every movement state. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-pirate-ship-red-coin-milestone
Camera control and first-person aiming: observed-bounded — Normal coaster aiming and camera use; not every camera mode or scene. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-mecha-bowser-milestone
FLUDD spray nozzle: observed-bounded — Controller-only Gatekeeper, Petey and Ricco routes exercise ordinary spraying and water use. Source: normal-world-routes.md

FLUDD hover nozzle: observed-bounded — Normal nozzle swaps and Hover transfers complete Pinna3; not every fuel or collision edge case. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-pirate-ship-red-coin-milestone

Goop removal and collision: observed-bounded — Normal airport and Delfino Gatekeeper progression exercises spray removal and gameplay collision; later goop variants remain open. Source: normal-world-routes.md

Enemy and boss combat: observed-bounded — Normal Gatekeeper, Petey, Gooper Blooper, Mecha Bowser, Cannon and five Pinna4 sunflower turtles; not all enemies or bosses. Source: normal-world-routes.md; pinna-normal-route.md

Grabbing, throwing and pulling: observed-bounded — Normal bomb handling and boss/object interactions; not every carryable object. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-cannon-and-block-secret-milestone
NPC dialogue and minigames: observed-bounded — Normal crate games and paid Pianta throw produce saved rewards; not every NPC script. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#earned-prerequisites-2026-10-19
Gold, red and blue coin rewards: observed-bounded — Hundred-coin reward, two normal sewer blue coins and Pinna3 eight-red-coin reward; not all coin identities. Source: pinna-normal-route.md
g.text: Gold, red and blue coin rewards

g.title: Shine collection and reward flow: observed-bounded — Fourteen distinct normally earned Shines are saved and cold loaded; not all 120 Shines. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-sunflower-milestone
World entry and episode selection: observed-bounded — Normal earned prerequisites, cannon entry and Pinna Episodes 1–4; later progression remains open. Source: pinna-normal-route.md
Moving platforms and pirate ships: observed-bounded — Normal Pinna2 block secret and Pinna3 ship transfers; not every platform or mechanism. Source: pinna-normal-route.md

FLUDD-less secret stages: observed-bounded — Normal Pinna2 secret completion and saved Shine31; other secret stages remain open. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-cannon-and-block-secret-milestone

Card save and fresh-process load: observed-bounded — Fourteen-Shine GCI, seven valid sector checksums and byte-identical normal cold reload; not every recovery/error path. Source: pinna-normal-route.md#complete-normal-sunflower-milestone

Death and restart lifecycle: partial — Normal death returns to Delfino are recorded; the combined transitions/death/restart/save lifecycle gate remains open. Source: normal-world-routes.md; ../../ROADMAP.md#open-work-in-order

Graphics, menus and HUD: partial — Owner-confirmed early picture and controls plus bounded rendering fixes; later scenes and full visual quality remain open. Source: clean-pc-test-2026-10-19.md; playability-matrix.tsv

Music, sound effects and movies: partial — Owner-confirmed sound on the private Clean-PC candidate; later-world/refill/death audio and full coverage remain open. Source: clean-pc-test-2026-10-19.md; playability-matrix.tsv
FLUDD rocket nozzle: unverified — No accepted normal rocket-nozzle acquisition/use milestone is recorded here; no missing-code claim. Source: ../../ROADMAP.md#open-work-in-order
FLUDD turbo nozzle: unverified — No accepted normal turbo-nozzle acquisition/use milestone is recorded here; no missing-code claim. Source: ../../ROADMAP.md#open-work-in-order
Yoshi riding and abilities: unverified — No accepted normal Yoshi unlock/riding/ability route is recorded here; no missing-code claim. Source: ../../ROADMAP.md#open-work-in-order

svg.text: Source: gameplay-features.tsv. This is a curated list, not a count of C++ functions.
Unverified does not mean missing code. Counts are not overall game completion.
